title: Pregnant Blend 3-Mix Duo #16 (동심원·물결 / 가로 띠·매끈)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, each an extraordinarily large pregnant woman, far beyond any real person.

#1: Japanese, in her early 40s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — but projecting forward from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, its taut round surface distinct from the heavier soft folds that continue below it toward her hips. Enormous round hips, gigantic soft thighs pressed together. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, fair porcelain skin, soft pink blush across the cheeks, sparkling pink eyeshadow, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy candy-pink lips, a sweet princess-like smile, a distinct two-tone ombre with dark roots and a sharp transition to light ends hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real pores, real living eyes, 50 bars piercings set with sapphires in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing a single piece of gold a ring. Painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 concentric regions around a single centre point located about 42% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure, separated by 2 hazy ring-shaped transition zones at about 20% and 72% of the way out from that centre point to the farthest edge of her figure. Region 1 is the innermost core around the centre point: it is painted in American Art Deco chrome-and-lacquer (a deep black lacquer ground with bold silver chrome sunburst), wide silver chrome bands following the contours of the body, with zigzag linework filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the ring between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Swedish Dalarna kurbits folk painting (a deep barn-red ground with bold cream and gold curling scrollwork), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with curling floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 3 is the outermost region beyond the last ring: it is painted in Korean eunipsa silver inlay (a deep black ground with thick bright silver linework), wide bold silver bands following the contours of the body, with lattice fills filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a perfectly circular course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: standing at a slight three-quarter angle, one hand resting on her own hip and the other beneath her belly's curve, composed radiant expression, her extreme platform clear heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Filipina, in her early 30s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term multiples pregnancy. Her pregnant belly is exceptionally wide as well as high, stretched into a broad, taut, smoothly rounded dome far wider than an ordinary single pregnancy, the navel pushed flat and outward at its highest point, faint linea nigra running down its centre. A full heavy bust above it, wide round hips below, soft thick thighs and arms. Her head looks small in comparison to her massive rounded middle. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm tan skin, heavy sculpted contour and a glowing highlighter on the cheekbones, smoky bronze and gold glitter eyeshadow, dramatic long lashes, defined dark brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy coral-red lips, a bright, confident pageant smile, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in countless fine micro braids, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of silver a hair ornament. Painted in 3 different traditional patterns, each claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, the patterns reading as a continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 horizontal bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 48% of the way down her figure from the top and about 74% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything above the first transition zone: it is painted in Turkish İznik tile (a brilliant white ground with cobalt-blue tulips and curling stems), wide cobalt-and-coral bands following the contours of the body, with floral scrollwork filling the space between bands. Region 2 is the band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it is painted in Ukrainian pysanka egg-art linework (a deep black ground with fine red, gold and white geometric linework), wide gold-and-red bands following the contours of the body, with geometric wax-resist linework filling the space between bands. Region 3 is everything below the last transition zone: it is painted in Croatian Hvar filigree-inspired linework (an ivory ground with fine cream and gold painted filigree linework), wide gold bands following the contours of the body, with fine filigree linework filling the space between bands. Where two regions meet, the patterns interlock naturally: motifs of one reach into the other and the two patterns simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring patterns, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. The bands of every pattern curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, one hand on the raised knee and the other cradling her belly, soft warm expression, her extreme platform high heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
